integrity: The verifier reconstructs all faces from the seventy-two tetrahedra, proves H1 has order five using an integral determinant certificate plus the mod-five rank drop, exhausts all three-vertex cliques, and enumerates every simplicial automorphism after a proven invariant-cell reduction.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the labelled fourteen-vertex L(5,2) triangulation. Oriented mod-five counts depend on the chosen cocycle and vertex orientation; the 82/82 unoriented balance, systolic count, full automorphism group, and induced unit action are intrinsic.
title: Perfectly balanced triangular torsion systoles in the fourteen-vertex lens space \(L(5,2)\)
